_purpose: Executable test cases (EC) — the runnable expansion of scenarios (SC). Per scenario: 1 success EC + EXACTLY one alternative EC per expected.alternative[] entry. Produced by phase-3-4-test-cases; validated by checks/test_case_coverage.py.
_status: EXAMPLE — expands the scenarios in 03-scenarios.json (SC-EX-01, SC-EX-03). Real output: qa/<epic>/PDT-XXXX-ucN-test-cases.json.
_id_note: EC- = Executable Case (this layer). Distinct from TC- (L3 test condition) and SC- (scenario). Chain: AC → SC → EC.
_rule: count(path=alternative EC for a scenario) MUST equal len(scenario.expected.alternative[]) — not fewer (gap), not more (over-test). alt_index maps each alternative EC to its scenario.expected.alternative[i].

cases.name: [Sign in] Verify a 6-character password is accepted
preconditions: Email field contains a valid address
steps: Enter admin@acme.co in the Email field
Enter Sunfl0 (6 chars) in the Password field
cases.expected_result: A password of 6 or more characters is accepted.

cases.name: [Sign in] Verify a 5-character password is rejected
preconditions: Email field contains a valid address
steps: Enter admin@acme.co in the Email field
Enter Sunf1 (5 chars) in the Password field
Assert: rejected with 'Your password must be 6 characters or more.'
cases.expected_result: A password of 5 characters (below min) is rejected with 'Your password must be 6 characters or more.'

cases.name: [Moderation] Verify a moderator approves a pending post
cases.expected_result: A moderator approving a pending post → status becomes published.

cases.name: [Moderation] Verify a member cannot approve (no permission)
cases.expected_result: A member (no permission) → Approve is hidden/blocked.

cases.name: [Moderation] Verify approve is blocked on a non-pending post
cases.expected_result: A moderator approving a non-pending post → blocked (wrong state).
